verdict.rationale: Carta documents its own first-party Claude MCP plugins that let an LLM answer natural-language questions about cap tables and fund data and generate tear sheets, budgets and financial statements. However, these AI outputs are produced inside Claude rather than natively in the Carta product, and there is no evidence of proactive insights or suggestions. missing for 10: native in-product AI insights/suggestions, proactive recommendations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: The Carta Investors plugin gives LLMs access to your fund's data and allows you to generate tear sheets, budgets, and financial statements.
Access ownership, stakeholder lists, SAFEs, convertible notes, option grants, 409A valuations, financing history, compensation benchmarks, and more — all with natural language questions.
build Excel budgets and consolidating P&L / balance sheets, and generate professional PDFs for investor reporting — all with natural language.
